_comment: Named capacity presets ward.py loads from — the 'a workflow that works for a large urban trauma centre may not transfer to a small rural ED' requirement made concrete. Same pathway/specialty vocabulary as layer5_routing.py's PATHWAYS map in every preset (routing logic doesn't change per hospital, only how much of each resource exists); an ED that genuinely lacks a service (e.g. no on-site vascular surgery) is represented as an empty roster, not omitted, so Layer 5 still reasons about it correctly as 'page required' rather than crashing on a missing key.

community_hospital.description: The default scenario — a mid-sized general ED, single site.

rural_ed.description: A small rural department — a handful of beds, one or two clinicians covering multiple specialties, no on-site surgical subspecialty.

urban_trauma_center.description: A large Level I urban trauma centre — multiple resus bays per specialty, a deeper on-call roster, higher baseline staffing.
